eveil.heroContent: Why yoga brings lasting change to body and mind — and how it can transform your daily life, from the very first breath.
eveil.introP1: Yoga is far more than a physical discipline: it is an age-old art of living that unites body, breath and mind. Every posture, every breath is an invitation to slow down and reconnect with yourself.
eveil.introP2: Open to everyone, whatever your age or level, yoga adapts to each person. It is not about performance, but a gradual practice whose effects are felt from the very first sessions — and deepen over time.
eveil.introP3: Whether you want to relieve physical tension, calm a restless mind or simply give yourself a moment that is yours alone, yoga has something to offer you.
eveil.benefitsSubtitle: A complete practice, with effects felt on every level.

benefits.title: The body
benefits.description: A regular practice loosens muscles and joints, strengthens the back and posture, and improves balance session after session.

benefits.title: The mind
benefits.description: Yoga soothes the mind: it helps release built-up tension, reduce stress and anxiety, and regain real mental clarity.

benefits.title: The breath
benefits.description: Breath work (pranayama) is at the heart of yoga: it teaches you to slow down, oxygenate the body better and calm the nervous system.

benefits.title: Daily life
benefits.description: On the mat and beyond, yoga cultivates a better attunement to yourself: more energy, more calm in the face of the unexpected, more presence with others.

eveil.quote: “Yoga is not about touching your toes, it is about what you learn on the way down.”
eveil.ctaText: Discover our video tutorials to start your yoga practice, whatever your level.
